verses.text: My son, keep my teaching fresh in your mind. Hold on to my commands with your whole heart.
They'll add days and years to your life and bring you peace.
Keep kindness and truth close. Tie them around your neck like a necklace and carve them into your heart.
Then God and people will look on you with favor and see that you have good sense.
Trust the LORD with your whole heart. Don't prop yourself up on what you think you know.
Recognize him in everything you do, and he'll straighten out the road ahead of you.
Don't look at yourself and think you've got it all figured out. Stand in awe of the LORD, and walk away from evil.
That'll bring health to your body and nourish you right down to your bones.
Honor the LORD with what you own and give him the first share of everything you bring in.
Your barns will be packed, and your vats will spill over with fresh wine.
My son, take the LORD's discipline seriously. Don't get tired of him correcting you.
The LORD corrects the people he loves, like a father correcting a son who brings him joy.
Happy is the person who finds wisdom and gets hold of understanding.
What wisdom earns you beats silver. What she pays back is worth more than pure gold.
She's worth more than rubies. Nothing you could want comes close.
She holds a long life in her right hand and wealth and honor in her left.
Her ways are a joy to walk, and every road she takes leads in peace.
She's a tree of life to anyone who grabs hold of her. Everyone who holds on to her is happy.
The LORD laid the earth's foundations with wisdom and set the heavens in place with understanding.
By his knowledge the deep waters split open and the sky lets dew fall.
My son, keep your eyes on these things. Hang on to sound wisdom and good judgment.
They'll give you life deep down and grace like a necklace around your neck.
Then you can walk your road safely without tripping.
When you lie down, you won't be scared. You'll be able to lie down and sleep sweetly.
Don't be afraid when terror comes out of nowhere or when ruin hits the wicked.
The LORD will be the one you can count on. He'll keep your foot from getting caught.
When it's in your power to do something good for someone who is owed it, don't hold back.
Don't tell your neighbor, “Go away and come back. I'll give it to you tomorrow,” when you've got it right there.
Don't plot against your neighbor who lives beside you and trusts you.
Don't start a fight with someone for no reason when they haven't done you wrong.
Don't envy a violent person. Don't pick up any of their ways.
The LORD is disgusted by crooked people, but he shares his friendship with people who live honestly.
The LORD's curse rests on the home of the wicked, but he blesses the home of those who do right.
He mocks the mockers, but he gives grace to the humble.
The wise will inherit honor. Shame is what fools get lifted up to.
